headline: ANCIENT STONE SLAB WITH MYSTERIOUS TRIPLE INSCRIPTION FOUND NEAR RASHID
dispatch: French soldiers excavating fortifications at Fort Julien near the Egyptian port of Rashid unearthed a large black stone slab yesterday bearing three distinct scripts carved in parallel rows. Officers on the scene noted the stone appears to carry identical text rendered in Greek letters alongside two unknown ancient scripts. The discovery has been forwarded to the scholars accompanying the expedition for urgent study.
answer: French soldiers uncover the Rosetta Stone, 1799
